why: The promulgated approving act itself: Resolucao n 88/2024 approves the Estrategia da Economia Digital de Cabo Verde 2024-2030, its six pillars and 37 objectives, and vests coordination in the Ministerio da Economia Digital through the DGTED.

Largest in-window movement: the Conselho de Ministros approved Resolucao n 72/2026 setting the strategic bases of the Agenda Digital de Cabo Verde 2035 in eight axes, superseding the horizon of the earlier instruments.

Distinct in-window event: presentation of the Estrategia Nacional para a Implementacao da Tecnologia 5G, later approved by Resolucao n 33/2026, with a phased NSA-first roadmap agreed with the regulator ARME.

No standalone cloud strategy exists; this full Boletim Oficial republication of the EGDCV is the instrument that states one, listing EST-TEC7 Cloud de Governo as already existing under the Infraestrutura e seguranca intervention area.

Only in-window movement by the operating institution: NOSi launched the photovoltaic energy system for the Data Center do Estado on 16 February 2026, an energy-resilience investment in the national data centre.

The operative instrument: Resolucao n 46/2025 creates the Portal Unico on the Infraestrutura Publica Digital whose blocks include Interoperabilidade, and article 6(m) requires the ESD to define the interoperability framework and make it mandatory for all e-government initiatives.

Decreto-Lei n 36/2026 puts the rules of access to data held by the State by electronic consultation on a statutory footing; already staged by a sibling slice from the per-act gazette PDF, so not restaged.

Distinct completed step: the Portal GOV.CV was launched on 24 February 2026, with the Prime Minister stating that the systems previously did not communicate and that the portal now delivers interoperability.

The instrument that settles a negative finding: no general data residency duty exists, and articles 19-20 of this republished data protection regime instead condition transfer abroad on adequacy, consent or CNPD authorisation. Already staged by a sibling slice from the same URL, so not restaged.

Only in-window movement: section 14 of the Ministerio da Saude and UGPE terms of reference requires that hosting for the surveillance solution be located in Cabo Verde. Already staged by a sibling slice from the same URL, so not restaged.

The enacting act as gazetted: Decreto-lei n 9/2021 establishes the cybersecurity legal regime, creates the Centro Nacional de Ciberseguranca, CSIRT.CV and the Nucleo Nacional de Seguranca, and adopts ECOWAS Directive C/DIR. 1/08/11.

Completed step rather than intention: the SOC and CSIRT of the Rede Tecnologica Privativa do Estado were publicly launched on 29 October 2025, putting into operation the incident-response capability the 2021 instruments created on paper.

The founding act: Decreto-Lei n 19/2014 creates the Cartao Nacional de Identificacao and the legal regime for its issue, replacement, use and cancellation. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

Completed in-window milestone: INCV began producing the CNI, the residence title and the electronic passport in-country, reducing dependence on external suppliers. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.
Distinct in-window step on the CNI stack: SNIAC released middleware version 1.9.9 for the national identity card. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

The single most authoritative instrument: Decreto-legislativo n 7/2018 establishes the legal regime for the regulation, management and operation of the Cabo-Verdean payment system. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

The only binding in-window regulatory movement: BCV Aviso n 01/2026 imposes transparency, verifiability and supervision duties that bind payment institutions and electronic money institutions. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

Distinct completed step: the BCV payment systems report records the completed pilot of the STII instant and inclusive transfer system with four commercial banks and SISP. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

The finding is negative and this is the primary record of it: the EGDCV annex marks EST-LEG9 Estrategia Nacional para a Inteligencia Artificial and EST-TEC23 Solucao de Inteligencia Artificial as Nao, and no AI statute has been adopted since.

The closest thing to an in-window regulator position on AI: the CNPD subscribed the joint declaration of data protection authorities on the risks of AI-generated content. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

Distinct in-window event: launch of the AILA national AI readiness assessment on 12 December 2025, assessing an ecosystem pillar, an AI-for-governance pillar and a regulation and ethics pillar to create a national baseline.

The operative statute: Lei n 48/IX/2019 establishes the principles, rules and structure of the Sistema Estatistico Nacional, superseding Lei n 35/VII/2009. Gazette record only, because the full-issue PDF timed out on three attempts.

The only qualifying in-window movement: INE adopted a completed policy operationalising article 10 paragraphs 7 and 15 of the SEN Law, setting access, safe-room, destruction and sanction conditions for anonymised microdata.

Cabo Verde has a dedicated statute and this is the gazette record of it: Lei n 10/X/2022 regulates access to and reuse of administrative documents and administrative information. The full text was not retrievable by any route.

Strongest completed in-window movement: launch of the Portal da Transparencia giving public access to state revenue, expenditure, procurement and transfers. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

Distinct institutional step: at the VII meeting of the OGP National Multistakeholder Forum the government began reforming the forum and preparing the III National Open Government Action Plan. Already staged by a sibling slice, so not restaged.

Resolucao n.o 153/IX/2020, the national act approving accession to the African Union Malabo Convention and publishing its Portuguese text; the instrument by which Cabo Verde harmonises to the regional framework

ECOWAS Conference, with Cabo Verde's President attending, adopts the Revised Supplementary Act on Personal Data Protection and approves a Regional Cybersecurity Coordination Mechanism; a completed step creating a new harmonisation obligation

Ministry of Finance record of the EllaLink landing at Praia and of the SHARE Praia-Dakar regional cable and the Amilcar Cabral network; already staged by a sibling slice under the same URL, so selected and not restaged
Member State experts including Cabo Verde validate the feasibility study for a second ECOWAS submarine cable; already staged by a sibling slice, so selected and not restaged

The operative statute: article 19 conditions transfer abroad on an adequate level of protection and vests the adequacy decision in the CNPD; article 20 sets the derogations and allows authorisation on sufficient guarantees, expressly including adequate contractual clauses
The CNPD signs a five-year renewable cooperation memorandum with Macau's data protection authority on 1 June 2026, a new formal channel over data moving between the two jurisdictions

The binding instrument: it imposes prior opinion on central-administration ICT acquisition and alignment with the transversal state solutions Autentika and PDEX, and stands in place of a separately promulgated technical interoperability standard, which Cabo Verde does not have

Decreto-Lei n.o 36/2026 makes interoperability with the Portal Unico mandatory, requires standardised APIs for electronic consultation of state-held data and enacts the only-once principle; already staged by a sibling slice, so selected and not restaged

The national standards catalogue itself, published by the national standards body: the whole Cabo Verdean corpus is 25 standards, NCV 001:2015 to NCV 025:2023, agricultural, fisheries, food and tourism, and none is an ICT or data standard

The 2026 budget law gives a 130 percent IRPC uplift on accreditation, management-system certification and calibration recognised by IGQPI, lowering the cost of using the national quality infrastructure; already staged by a sibling slice, so selected and not restaged
State port operator ENAPOR states on the record that it certified to ISO 9001 during 2025, with ISO 27001 still an intention for 2026; a completed certification of a Cabo Verdean public enterprise

The supreme instrument, carrying the right of petition, representation, claim and complaint and the right of popular action, and the press-freedom articles guaranteeing independence of public-sector media and their journalists from the Government and the administration

The VII meeting of the OGP National Multisector Forum, held 26 February 2026, reformulates the Forum membership to give civil society and academia more weight and opens preparation of the III National Action Plan for Open Government; a completed institutional step

The incoming government programme commits to permanent consultation mechanisms with unions, business, civil society and communities, participatory budgeting in every municipality, digital public-consultation platforms and effective implementation of the access-to-information law, naming abstention and polarisation as weakening public debate

Despacho n.o 16/2015 designating the Centro de Dados do Estado at Achada Grande as critical infrastructure; the national act establishing that the facility exists, is state-held and houses processing and storage equipment. No Cabo Verdean source located publishes a national capacity inventory

NOSi launches the photovoltaic energy system for the state Data Center at the Parque Tecnologico on 16 February 2026, a commissioned expansion of the primary facility supporting infrastructure; already staged by a sibling slice, so selected and not restaged

Most recent authoritative statement of the standing position: 97 percent access, 482.6 GWh production in 2023, 77.9 MW peak, ELECTRA total losses of 22.71 percent in 2025, and the unbundling into EPEC, ONSEC and EDEC. Published in-window, so it is both position and movement and is counted once, as the baseline

Inauguration on 11 February 2026 of the EUR 30 million Palmeira power station extension doubling Sal thermal capacity and of a EUR 6 million battery storage system raising island renewable storage sevenfold, both stated as improving stability and quality of supply

First phase complete on Boa Vista: transformer and sectioning posts adapted for remote monitoring and control from the national dispatch centre in Praia, ahead of the island joining the national SCADA-based dispatch system

The national statistics office own published series and the most recent authoritative publication of it: 79.7 percent of the population in 2010 rising to 94.3 percent in 2023. The published indicator carries no urban and rural split, which is itself the finding
World Bank approval of USD 13.30 million IDA concessional finance for REIUP, funding 1,800 further household connections and last-mile electrification against a stated 98 percent coverage rate

The Prime Minister quantifies the rural programme to parliament: 400 thousand contos already invested in rural electrification and 300 thousand contos in execution on network extensions, mini-grids and solar kits, with access at 86 percent in 2015 and 98 percent in 2024 against a 100 percent target for 2026

The founding instrument: Decreto-Lei n.o 13/2014 converts NOSi from a 2003 project structure into a public business entity with its own Statute, mandated to develop, integrate, secure and operate state information systems and the state private network and to export integrated e-governance services

Decree approving the financing agreement signed 31 December 2025 with the African Development Bank, up to EUR 17,710,000, for phase II of the e-governance and public financial management reform programme; a completed legal step enlarging the financing base for state digital systems capability

NOSi launches the Cybersecurity Operations Centre and the Digital Security Incident Response Team for the state private network, new standing in-country capability to run and defend government systems, delivered with World Bank financing and an external implementation partner

The affordability measure itself carrying Cabo Verde values - the ITU price-basket table naming Cabo Verde among the three largest 2022-23 declines in three mobile baskets. No national ARME affordability index or price basket was located.

The operative concession instrument: it requires an autonomous wholesale division to manage and operate the inter-island fibre Backbone Network and the International Hub. A statute beats the news of it.

EUR 37 million sovereign guarantee to CVTelecom underwriting an EIB loan to modernise the inter-island submarine cable and international connectivity; the government primary carries the amount and the purpose, which the gazette index page does not.

The standing state of international capacity from a national primary: EllaLink landed at Praia at 30 TB, more than all previous cables serving Cabo Verde combined, plus SHARE Dakar-Praia at 16 Tbit/s design capacity. No current ITU or ARME bandwidth-per-user series exists - the WTID was discontinued in 2024.

Feasibility study for a second submarine cable serving Cabo Verde reviewed and approved at Monrovia, 22-24 October 2025; Cabo Verde is named as a participating country, so this is a national step and not a regional document standing in for one.

The regulator publishes Q1 2026 market indicators - 511,702 internet subscriptions, fixed broadband up 12.9 per cent, Starlink at 0.64 per cent share, international incoming voice traffic down 6.9 per cent. It measures international connectivity in use; it publishes no bandwidth series.

The registry record for the exchange itself: CV-IXP, Praia, status Active, established 29 November 2022, with IPv4 and IPv6 peering subnets assigned. No enacting decree was located; it is a private non-profit association.

The only in-window primary movement located: the government states twice that it has introduced the IXP, with an impact on cost, latency and internet quality, placing it as operational rather than planned.

The platform itself rather than the law about it: PDEX publishes state data as APIs under owner-set conditions and names four live integrations - Portal Consular over civil identification, NhaCard over the national health system, the Treasury DUC, and citizen and company validation APIs.

The binding framework for digital public services through the Portal Unico and for electronic consultation of state-held data - the consolidating act for the national interoperability layer. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

Launch of the Portal da Transparencia exposing state financial data in real time, presented as part of the digital identity, interoperability and inter-institutional data-sharing architecture. A distinct event. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

The mechanism by which the national digital identity is consumed by other systems: CNI and Chave Movel Digital authentication plus qualified signature, open to any duly authorised online service, integrated over OpenID Connect, with more than 95,000 daily users. Decreto-Lei 27/2023 ranked higher on paper but its act text could not be fetched.

Launch of the GOV.CV single window on 24 February 2026, the Prime Minister stating the move from isolated platforms that did not communicate to one portal guaranteeing interoperability, so a citizen stops fetching documents the State already holds. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

Legal basis for electronic acts through the Portal Unico and for electronic access to state-held data, with elevated authentication on the CNI and NIC. A distinct event from the portal launch. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

The most recent authoritative statement of position: SIS maturity scored at 55 per cent, the Estrategia Nacional de Saude Digital 2024-2034 published, and interoperability achieved between the National and Regional Health Observatories. It also carries in-window movement, so it counts once, as the baseline.

Cooperation protocol signed and equipment delivered for death certification and cause-of-death notification, with the process revised jointly across the health, civil registry and national statistics sectors, inside the DHIS-2 and ICD-11 modernisation.

Procurement opened for an interoperable laboratory system across 20 laboratories requiring HL7/FHIR and integration with DHIS2 and the SIS, stating that all inter-institution data exchange must run through PDEX and that applications must register with Autentika. A distinct event from the death-registration protocol.

The operative act making SIGE the single mandatory national school data system: assessment results must be recorded electronically on SIGE and all public, semi-public and private schools in the national system must adopt it.

USD 1 million GPE grant for PRISE 2026-2028, naming expansion and modernisation of the SIGE platform and implementation of the Barometro Nacional do Sistema Educativo among its technical areas. [Repointed at merge onto the surviving capture of the same URL; the two bodies were identical.]

The GOV.CV launch, which brings education services including the Dossier do Aluno into the single interoperable portal. Selected in place of the trade-press report of the same event. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

The operating ministry describing the system itself: the Cadastro Social Unico created by Decreto Regulamentar 7/2018, the reference database for municipalities, the water and electricity operators, the Health, Education, Housing and Family ministries and the CNPS, and the precondition for any safety-net benefit. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

Benefit-managing entities can now query CSU beneficiary and household records directly at the point of service, ending the printed municipal declaration - a concrete cross-institution data exchange step rather than a coverage announcement.

Registration drive extending the CSU to households in climate-vulnerable zones so they are identifiable for cash transfers, food security support and resilience programmes. A distinct event; coverage expansion of the registry other systems consume.

The instrument that ties the two together: the CNI is optional from birth and compulsory from age four, its Numero de Identificacao Civil is generated through the SNIAC connection, and card personalisation draws on the birth registration act including filiation. Lei 43/VIII/2013 ranked higher on paper but its Boletim Oficial capture truncated before that law.

First usage figures since launch - 905 acts, of which 290 birth certificates and 150 online CNI renewals - showing civil registry output and identity document service running through one digital channel. [Repointed at merge onto the surviving capture of the same URL; the two bodies were identical.]

Authorises electronic public-service acts through the Portal Unico and electronic consultation of state-held data, the legal pathway for interoperable civil-registry and identification services. A distinct event. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

The Ministry of Justice describing SNIAC as the central, cross-cutting system and the central data provider to every other administrative subsystem, supplying the data for the CNI, the electronic passport and the residence title. The underlying Lei 43/VIII/2013 could not be captured. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

Makes the Portal Unico the transactional channel for integrated digital public services, establishes electronic consultation of state-held data and once-only duties, and provides elevated authentication on the CNI and NIC. Already staged by a sibling slice; not restaged.

CNI middleware version 1.9.9 released 17 March 2026 with the SDK that lets public or private institutions authenticate the holder, read card data and collect a digital signature in their own applications - a dated enabling step, though it names no newly onboarded institution.

Decreto-legislativo 7/2018 is the enacting instrument for the Sistema de Pagamentos Cabo-Verdiano and the act conferring the BCV its superintendencia, rule-making, inspection and settlement roles; the statute itself, not a description of it. One file and two selected rows: the same bulletin is also the consumer-protection baseline because it carries Decreto-legislativo 8/2018.

Most structural in-window movement: the new BCV organic law replacing the 2002 statute, raising share capital and reorganising the Bank's governance and supervisory functions. Primary text, not the news of it.

Distinct second event: the governor announcing SPEED, a national instant-transfer system, after a completed four-bank pilot, with the BCV acting as architect and coordinator of new payments infrastructure alongside banks, regulator and Government.

The standing instrument for 2026: public salaries and pensions processed through SIGOF and the HR databases and credited to beneficiaries' bank accounts on stated datas-valor, DNOCP processing pensions, and direct transfers to families abroad via CNPS and the diplomatic representations. Itself in-window, so it counts once, as the baseline.

Portaria 28/2012 approves the Documento Unico de Cobranca and its specifications - the founding act for electronic collection of state revenue, dematerialised, carrying a payment reference for automatic processing and payable over the state network including Vinti4 and home banking.

Decreto-Lei 36/2026 sets the rules for taxes and charges due for digital public services through the Portal Unico, providing for payment by electronic platforms, ATM, physical and digital terminals and digital wallets, with a 10 per cent reduction through the portal.

Distinct second measure: every state Recebedoria must hold systems adapted to the DUC and integrated with the DGT control system, with electronic reporting of payments and revenue payable by POS, ATM, mobile telephone and homebanking. Same file as the G2P baseline, so it sits under baseline/ - baseline wins on folder.

The BCV's own record of SICIL, the national interbank clearing and settlement system including the electronic credit transfer subsystem, managed by BCV with daily operation delegated to SISP and net balances settled in the SGDL - the rail on which business and government transfers actually run.

State-side mandate: central-administration procurement must run on the Plataforma Electronica da Contratacao Publica and payment for goods and services is conditioned on electronically issued invoices, closing the loop between B2G contracting, e-invoicing and public payment. Same file as the G2P baseline.

Business-side lever and a distinct measure from the state-side mandate: a 130 per cent IRPC uplift on the cost of adopting the fatura electronica and installing SAFT-CV, plus certified-software and QR Code/IUD requirements on invoices.

The BCV's account of what the national retail rail actually does: ATM and POS transfers and service payments, TeleVinti4 mobile account access on both networks, Vinti4net internet banking, and web payment acceptance for merchants - person-to-person, person-to-government and person-to-business on one rail.

Strongest dated quantitative movement: SISP figures for 15-25 December 2025 showing 2,079,630 Vinti4 operations worth 9,036,496,578 escudos, transfers up 45 per cent in number and 53.9 per cent in value, and 1,637,127 POS purchases.

The person-to-government side of the same indicator: the Portal Unico decree moves citizen payment of state charges onto a single digital channel with electronic platforms, terminals and digital wallets. Distinct event from the SISP volume figures.

Release of the BCV Relatorio do Sistema de Pagamentos on 24 September 2025, carrying the uptake series: 380,545 active cards, up 15.6 per cent; 132,405 card operations a day; TeleVinti4 up 148.7 per cent; 13,249 POS and 232 ATMs, 233.5 POS and 4.5 ATMs per 10,000 inhabitants. No baseline row: the authoritative published figure for this indicator, the SISP annual report 2024, is already held in the base and was dropped DUP-EXACT.

Second distinct measured movement, three months later and from the network operator rather than the central bank: SISP's December 2025 Vinti4 volumes and their year-on-year growth. Same file as the P2P progress row.

Decreto Legislativo 3/2018 is the standing national instrument for economic and financial operations with the exterior and for exchange operations, making contracting and settlement of transfers generally free, permitting foreign-currency accounts and placing operations under authorised intermediation and BCV supervision. National, not a regional substitute.

Second selected row on the same bulletin: it carries Decreto-legislativo 8/2018, the codified regime for payment services and electronic money, whose stated purpose is to preserve consumer choice under better conditions of security and cost efficiency and which governs information and transparency duties, reimbursement and liability for unauthorised operations. Taken here because the Aviso 5/2022 bulletin truncated before that Aviso's operative text.

Clearest in-window regulatory movement: a new BCV Aviso on financial advertising binding payment and e-money institutions, requiring an advertising policy, forbidding concealment of commissions and charges, restricting named expressions and empowering the BCV to suspend or rectify campaigns. Full primary text.

Distinct outcome-side event: publication of the BCV behavioural supervision results for 2025 - 278 complaints, fraud up 150 per cent to 25 which the BCV attributes to digitalisation of financial services, 25 supervisory measures and 3,154,582 escudos restored to consumers.

Ministry of Justice description of the SNIAC itself: the central civil identification and authentication system created by Lei 43/VIII/2013, coordinated by the DGRNI, and the central data provider for the CNI, electronic passport and residence title
Domestic production of state identity documents begins 11 June 2026 with the Centro de Personalizacao fully operational, 1,200 CNI/TRE a day and 79,600 CNI a year projected
Distinct earlier event: the two contracts with INCM Portugal and Correios de Cabo Verde that put the personalisation and distribution chain for the CNI in place
Lei 75/VIII/2014 approving the Codigo do Registo Civil, the constitutive instrument of civil registration and of the national electronic civil registry database, repealing the 1967 regime
INE released its fifth Estatisticas Vitais report on 1 October 2025, built on RNI administrative records: 6,760 births, 2,925 deaths, 2,435 marriages for 2023 and register-quality detail
Distinct event: the DGRNI itself began routine publication of registry throughput under a new RNI em Numeros rubric, reporting 2,944 birth registrations across 23 conservatorias in H1 2026

No standalone national address register exists; the INGT national toponymy dataset, covering streets and numeros de policia and grounded in Decreto-Lei 5/2012, is the nearest national artefact and its metadata record is the thing itself
Praia municipal toponymy platform launched October 2025 and confirmed live: residents can look up official street names and building numbers across the capital
Distinct event: Boa Vista begins island-wide toponymy and door numbering from Sal Rei, building an address database for postal, emergency, census and delivery use

The operating ministry description of the Cadastro Social Unico created by Decreto Regulamentar 7/2018: the register of households, its targeting indicator and its status as the precondition of any safety-net benefit
Clearest in-window scale statement: 16,036 additional households registered and the CSU now holding data for over 91,164 households, about 64 per cent of the population, as of February 2026
Distinct event: Portaria Conjunta 16/2026 extends CSU group classification into State housing allocation, widening the register as a cross-programme gateway
Lei 22/VII/2008 creating and regulating the Base de Dados do Recenseamento Eleitoral, the constitutive instrument of the electoral roll as a digital system under article 67 of the Codigo Eleitoral
The register operator publishes Edital 1/DGAPE/2026, the global elector map at 28 April 2026: 419,755 registered, 347,704 in the territory and 72,051 in the diaspora

Distinct event: the CNE sets the roll operating cycle for the 17 May 2026 elections - registration closes 12 March, cadernos on public display to 23 March, claims to 28 March, unalterable from 17 April

The revenue administration own statement of the taxpayer register: compulsory registration on Model 110 at the Reparticao de Financas, identity evidence required, legal basis Decreto-Lei 89/2005, with an online NIF lookup
Decreto-Lei 34/2025 creates the Autoridade Tributaria e Aduaneira de Cabo Verde, moving custody of the taxpayer register from the DNRE to a new authority
Distinct completed step: the DNRE, Customs and Contributions director posts lapse and the ATCV Conselho Diretivo is appointed, turning the November 2025 creation into an operating body

The cadastral authority own description of the Cadastro Predial, its compulsory inscription, the distinction from the registo predial and the computerised national cadastral database; the current Decreto-Lei 12/2024 regime is already held in the corpus
Only in-window movement on the cadastre: the Infrastructure Minister announces its resumption in the Government Programme debate of 17 July 2026, alongside a national toponymy programme

The Ministry of Education description of SIGE, the national school management system built with NOSi: piloted 2009, complete in all 43 secondary schools by July 2018 and all 395 basic schools by February 2019, carrying the Dossier do Aluno
GPE approved a US$1 million grant on 8 April 2026 funding PRISE 2026-2028, whose named activities include the expansion and modernisation of the SIGE platform

No integrated sectoral platform exists; this is the clearest dated evidence of the delivery systems that do - the INPS/IEFP SASD platform managing unemployment benefit from application through award to payment
Budget execution decree of 9 January 2026 routes pensions through SIGOF and makes proof of life automatic by cross-matching the Registo, Notariado e Identificacao against the pensioners database

Distinct event: INPS Mobile presented at the 6th IGF Cabo Verde after winning the Digital Awards prizes for public innovation and best mobile application, evidencing the self-service channel in live operation

The revenue administration operating description of electronic filing: registration in the area virtual privada on portondinosilha.cv, portal entry or XML upload to published specification, validation, submission, next-day status and DUC payment

The 2026 Budget Law grants a 130 per cent deduction for accounting and invoicing software in the course of adopting electronic invoicing and installing SAFT-CV, with a Pro-Empresa programme for REMPE taxpayers

Distinct event: a US$15 million World Bank development policy credit whose tax prior actions are the autonomous revenue authority and the VAT revision to full electronic invoicing with real-time reporting

Sydonia World, the UNCTAD ASYCUDAWorld customs system, entering operation across the whole territory on 14 September 2015: paperless DAU, transit and collection guides, online dossier tracking and planned integration with JUP, TCE, INE and the Treasury

Technical review of 9 July 2026 reports the migration to SYDONIA World 4.4.0, infrastructure modernisation, ASYVAL customs value controls, new modules and integration services under the Cabo Verde Digital Project

Distinct event: UGPE procurement of 3 February 2026 for a full revision of the Customs Code and its regulation, expressly to align it with the digital economy and electronic customs management systems

Independent MCC evaluation of LMITS/SIGTP: the system is functioning, integrated into the transaction process and used for most land transactions, with registry median times falling from 21 to 5 days on Sal and 12 days to under a day on Sao Vicente

NOSi own strategic plan is the operating institution dated statement of the Sistema de Informacao Municipal and its coverage: SIM 2.0 implemented nationally 2008-2012 and functioning in all municipalities with uneven functionality, with SIMple defined as the integrated paperless successor
Workshop of 11 November 2025 presenting the work developed on Projeto SIMple, the update of the municipal information system, with municipal staff training programmed alongside it
Completed contract award of 19 March 2026 for the electronic procurement platform, redefined in 2025 to extend to the Administracao Local, at 70 million escudos over four years

The Ministry of Health terms of reference state the standing position: DHIS2 in production across all SNS structures, the M1 electronic patient record used only in Praia, and the roll-out scope named as three regional hospitals and 32 health centres across ten islands and 22 municipalities

Handover on 18 December 2025 of 24 telemedicine units and 24 videoconference systems, with the Ministry stating all 22 municipalities will have at least one fully equipped facility and the programme integrated into the health information system

Resolucao 149/2025 adopting the Carta Sanitaria 2025 as a binding planning instrument whose section 8 integrates interoperable information systems, telemedicine and AI-assisted diagnosis into the SNS across the territorial network

The Ministry of Education own page for the school management system, giving the national coverage figure: SIGE completed in all 395 escolas do ensino basico in February 2019 [Repointed at merge onto the surviving capture of the same URL; the two bodies were identical.]

Ministry broadcaster report of the 14 July 2026 review at which the Akelius digital education project met its targets in 14 schools across five islands, quoting the head of the rural Sao Martinho Grande school grouping

Decreto-Lei 43/2007 is the enacting act putting registration acts, their archiving and their means of proof on an electronic footing and allowing a certidao to be requested at any conservatoria or through the Casa do Cidadao

Decreto-Lei 36/2026 of 21 May 2026 makes the Portal Unico the transactional channel for electronic public services and acts, including registo and notariado, with rules on fees and electronic consultation of state data
First published usage figures for the Portal da Justica on 16 December 2025: 905 registry acts performed without attendance at a conservatoria, itemised by act type
Portaria Conjunta 50/2024 is the act declaring phased operation of the SIJ and its criminal-process subsystem and making electronic criminal process obligatory in the Policia Nacional
Completion on 28 November 2025 of SIJ installation on Brava, the smallest and most remote inhabited island, bringing all 17 comarcas into the system

Signature on 13 April 2026 of the memorandum for the third phase of Cidade Segura, wholly financed by China, to widen video surveillance coverage, with Santa Catarina, Tarrafal and Porto Novo named as the expansion municipalities

The Ministry of Digital Economy standing strategy of September 2024 carries measure MI 9, Implementar uma Estrategia de IA, as still to be done, establishing that there is no enacted standalone national AI strategy

On 23 October 2025 the Ministry of Justice presented the Portal da Justica and demonstrated its Inteligencia Artificial Integrada initiative, including an AI chat for citizens reaching judicial information and services

Start on 22 September 2025 of the first national AI training for justice professionals, 226 enrolled over thirty hours, covering intelligent management of judicial proceedings and practical AI applications in law

With no standalone AI statute in force, this amendment of the data protection regime is the instrument that reaches abusive algorithmic use: profiling, limits on solely automated decisions, transparency of decision logic and impact assessments for high-risk technologies

On 27 February 2026 the CNPD subscribed to the joint declaration of 61 data protection authorities on AI-generated images, setting requirements on security against non-consensual intimate imagery, transparency, takedown mechanisms and safeguards for children

The regulator dated statement of the gap: at the Accra AI governance workshop of 29 September to 1 October 2025 the CNPD set out the data protection provisions bearing on AI and stated that the country needs legislation to regulate AI

Resolucao 113/2021 approves the digital governance strategy whose intervention area Literacia Digital dos Recursos Humanos, with programme EST-ADM7, is the standing national policy on digital literacy of public servants

First national AI training for justice professionals, begun 22 September 2025 with 226 enrolled from all islands and municipalities over thirty hours, the largest dated digital-skills delivery to public servants in the window

Training on personal data processing run by the revenue authority with the CNPD on 12 February 2026 for 126 DNRE staff, part of a February and March cycle also covering biometrics and electronic means in the workplace
